task.description: Step 2 of WF-03: produce fix design artefact for ISS-0112. Design includes a corrective migration numbered at the next available slot (current top is GBL-104; next is GBL-105). The migration must reconcile public + tenant schema ledgers and be idempotent.
Design includes a new tools/verify_schema_baseline.py per docs/guides/test_infrastructure_guide.md §6

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/fix-iss0112.md written; 5-change plan covers corrective migration (GBL-105_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql), applier guard in Migrations.runForSchema (force_reconcile flag + reapply_on_drift header convention), per-test isolation refactor of ensureDefaultOidcSeeds (tenant_type=test on default tenant + SVC fixture INSERTs relocated to per-test files), cleanup broadening in tools/clean_test_db.py (--include-fixtures flag), and new tools/verify_schema_baseline.py enforcing docs/guides/test_infrastructure_guide.md §6.
